## Detection parameters (EPISODE_CFG snapshot)

| Parameter | Value | Provenance |
|-----------|-------|------------|
| `accel_z_smooth_days` | 5 | accel_z raw median run = 2d; 5d suppresses noise |
| `onset_accel_z_threshold` | 1.0 | panel_s q87 of accel_z ≈ 1.0 |
| `onset_positive_days_in_5` | 3 | majority-positive 5d window |
| `onset_rs_mom_positive` | True | see EPISODE_CFG docstring |
| `confirmed_consecutive_onset_days` | 5 | mirrors smoothing window |
| `confirmed_cohesion_chg_threshold` | 0.056 | panel_m cohesion_chg q75 = 0.056 |
| `undeniable_rs_in_direction` | True | RS must flip sign in onset direction |
| `undeniable_breadth_threshold` | 0.5 | breadth_50 q50 ≈ 0.53 → threshold 0.50 |
| `mature_rs_pctile_threshold` | 0.8 | q80 of trailing 252d rank = 0.80 |
| `mature_fading_accel_z_threshold` | 0.5 | below ~q75/1.2 ≈ 0.50 |
| `exhausted_accel_z_counter_threshold` | -0.5 | counter-directional band |
| `exhausted_days_in_5` | 3 | 3-of-5 confirmation |
| `hysteresis_gap_days` | 5 | one trading week re-arm gap |
| `min_duration_before_exhaustion` | 5 | prevents zero-length episodes |
| `outcome_horizons` | [5, 21, 63] | 5/21/63d = weekly/monthly/quarterly |
| `two_sided_min_overlap_sessions` | 5 | ≥5 session co-movement |
| `two_sided_min_cohesion` | 0.25 | see EPISODE_CFG docstring |
| `open_episode_fallback_days` | 90 | see EPISODE_CFG docstring |
| `rs_pctile_window_d` | 252 | see EPISODE_CFG docstring |
| `rs_pctile_min_valid` | 126 | see EPISODE_CFG docstring |
| `confirm_window_m` | 5 | see EPISODE_CFG docstring |
